rule: The announcements are the FOMC, Non-farm payroll, GDP (first and last), ISM manufacturing PMI, and the earlier of the CPI and PPI announcements. (C9 / K9-anncday-01, P-K9C-003-c); inflation: "We combine the PPI and CPI announcements into one “inflation” announcement by using the earlier one each month" (P-K9C-003-d); mapping (catalog round 2 item 11): FOMC = statement day of each scheduled meeting; NFP = Employment Situation release day; GDP first = advance estimate, last = third estimate; inflation = the earlier of CPI and PPI per reference month; ISM dates are scheduled dates. Dates known in advance only (known before the 17:59 CT entry intent on the evening before d).

questions.topic: Unscheduled FOMC meetings, notation votes and press releases in the window
questions.evidence: The Fed historical pages label these "(unscheduled)" or "(notation vote)". None is among the meetings on the Fed calendars captured 2018-12-20 (2019 schedule) and 2019-12-20 (2020 schedule), which list the scheduled meetings only. No source found shows any of them announced before the evening before (writer's reading; the lead rules). 2020-03-15 is a Sunday (no trade date d of its own). 2020-08-27 is the Statement on Longer-Run Goals and Monetary Policy Strategy (the E.10 analogue 2025-08-22 was ruled not a meeting, CAL-FED-3).

questions.evidence: May 2019 - Jul 2020: each scheduled date is also confirmed as the actual release by the "FOR RELEASE:" line of the next capture of the manufacturing report page.
